errors.location: Comparison with PyZX paragraph and Table I heading
errors.description: The manuscript concludes that Qsyn is faster, uses less memory, and produces circuits with equal-or-lower RZ counts and lower average depth, but supplies no table values or experimental protocol in the provided text. The claims of superior performance and a fair comparison therefore cannot be independently assessed from the reported evidence.
errors.evidence: “We demonstrate Qsyn’s superior performance through fair comparisons with PyZX”; “Qsyn tended to optimize circuits with shorter program runtimes and lower memory usage”; Table I is introduced as examining “run time and memory usage,” but only its heading is present.
